snip.t: He has balanitis with paraphimosis, and staphylococcal or streptococcal infections are most likely to be present.
There is an increased risk for phimosis and for balanitis in uncircumcised males.
This describes balanitis; Candida is the most common causative organism, especially with the thick discharge and itching described, particularly in uncircumcised men (also associated with diabetes).
snip.s: Male Reproductive & Urinary Tract Pathology Questions MKU Year 3

snip.t: Also: circinate balanitis and keratoderma blennorrhagica.

snip.t: Penile lesions: balanitis, phimosis, warts (HPV), herpes, syphilitic chancre, squamous cell carcinoma (see the penile notes), and penile curvature (chordee, Peyronie's).
snip.s: Urology: History, Examination and Common Presenting Symptoms

snip.t: Penis: foreskin (phimosis, paraphimosis, balanitis, balanitis xerotica obliterans/lichen sclerosus), the external meatus (hypospadias, meatal stenosis, discharge), the shaft (plaques of Peyronie's, lesions), and the glans (cancer).
snip.s: Urology: History, Examination and Common Presenting Symptoms
